newsitem.title: UK: London platinum, palladium fix at fresh lows.
newsitem.headline: London platinum, palladium fix at fresh lows.

text.p: Platinum fixed at $374.25 an ounce on Thursday morning, the lowest fixing since December 6, 1993, pressed lower by selling in the Far East overnight.
Its sister metal palladium was also set lower, fixing at $114.25 an ounce, the lowest since April 16, 1993.
On Wednesday platinum was fixed at $376.35, its lowest setting since December 7, 1993.
The metal has been under pressure all week since investor disillusionment with a sluggish gold market sent prices tumbling across the precious metals sector.
News that imports by Japan, the world's leading user of platinum, fell 28.8 percent in October this year compared with October 1995 provoked fresh selling in Japan, dealers said.
Japanese palladium imports were off 26.9 percent in October compared with the same month last year, acccording to Finance Ministry data released on Thursday.
